title: Keepsake Ring
summary: Cast level 5 Dominate Beast once per Long Rest.

fields.Cast: Action once per Long Rest. Cast level 5 Dominate Beast on one Beast within 60 ft. Wisdom save against your spell save DC. Concentration, up to 10 turns.
fields.On failure: The Beast fights on your side. Each time it takes damage, it can end the effect with a Wisdom save against your spell save DC.
fields.Acquisition: Elfsong Tavern basement in the rat room, X −859, Y 531.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
